dogecoin.text: German fashion brand Philipp Plein has started accepting "#Bitcoin, #Dogecoin, #Ethereum and some other cryptocurrencies" as payment. Philipp Plein, one of the biggest fashion brands, announced the news by crowning himself as the "crypto king" on his Instagram account. https://t.co/EHGhn9kROQ

English football club #Watford FC, competing in the Premier League, made an agreement with #Dogecoin for the arm sponsorship of the jersey. The team will carry the Dogecoin logo on their 2021-2022 season jerseys.
